components.name: Athletics masthead
components.limits: Keep logo 50px; brand treatment fixed.

components.name: Aggie AM masthead
components.limits: Use once, beneath utility bar; retain authentic logo.

components.name: Preferences & postal footer
components.limits: Required. Preserve opt-out distinction. Replace with approved Eloqua footer only after equivalent behavior is verified.

components.name: Statement hero
components.limits: Eyebrow ≤45 chars; headline ≤65; summary ≤120. No background image dependency.

components.name: Lead story
components.limits: Headline ≤70 chars; body ≤85 words. Facts from supplied edition, not independently verified.

components.name: Two-story rail
components.limits: Each headline ≤48 chars; summary ≤40 words. Two equal cells stack on mobile.

components.name: The Rundown
components.limits: 3–7 items; ≤35 words each. Keep losses factual and neutral.

components.name: Moment / motion feature
components.limits: Image 528px wide at desktop, fluid on mobile; readable static first frame required. Animation is optional.

components.name: Away game matchup
components.limits: Display timezone after confirmation. The supplied email omits it; do not infer for send. Home/neutral language may be edited, not geometry.

components.name: Final score
components.limits: Win/loss neutral labels; no color-only result indicator. Scores ≤3 digits.

components.name: Upcoming schedule
components.limits: 3 default rows; 1–7 supported. No schedule intro line (source explicitly removed it). Times are source samples pending confirmation.

components.name: Player spotlight
components.limits: ≤60-word summary; no invented quotes or athlete endorsements.

components.name: Three-stat strip
components.limits: Values ≤5 chars; labels ≤12. One-stat variant: remove two cells and set width 100%.

components.name: Milestone panel
components.limits: ≤50 words; verify historical claim with sports information before sending.

components.name: Dugout Club campaign
components.limits: Source membership offer; reconfirm availability and terms. This is a membership promotion, not a single-game ticket price.

components.name: Event essentials
components.limits: Game-day sample is away. Add parking/gates only from approved venue guidance.

components.name: Primary action
components.limits: Label ≤28 chars. No invented scarcity, price, seat or inventory claims.

components.name: Presenting sponsor
components.limits: Required for Aggie AM; do not apply sponsor to other campaigns without contracted entitlement. Keep 16px clear space.

components.name: Sponsor banner
components.limits: Preserve source placement before Rundown. Artwork review required: legal copy must remain readable at 320px; never crop disclaimers.

components.name: Section break
components.limits: 8px vertical / 36px horizontal. Structural only; cannot replace a heading.

components.name: Utility bar & notice
components.limits: Use once at top. Send-blocking status stays in catalog, outside email markup.
